description: Answer-level baseline for the default answering model (claude-haiku-5-5, effort low), checked by hand: ikg eval --llm --check eval/baseline-llm.json. Not run in CI because it calls the Claude API (about $0.04 per run). Model answers vary between runs, so re-run before treating a small drop as a regression. Update it in the same PR as any change that legitimately moves these numbers.
